sn43.10:1.1: Katamo ca bhikkhave asaṅkhatagami maggo || || Sattabojjhaṅgā ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmi maggo || || 3 Katamo ca bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmi maggo || || Ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmi maggo || 4 Iti kho bhikkhave vedayitaṃ vo mayā asaṅkhataṃ desito asaṅkhatagāmi maggo || || 5 Yam bhikkhave satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampena anukampam upādāya kataṃ vo tam mayā || || 6 Etāni bhikkhave rukkhamulāni etāni suññāgārāni jhāyatha bhikkhave mā pamādattha mā pacchāvippatisārino ahuvattha || ayaṃ vo amhākam anusāsanīti || || Nibbānasaṃyuttassa pathamo vaggo || || Kāyo Samatho Vitakko || Suññato Satipaṭṭhānā || Sammappadhānā Iddhipādā Indriya-
